routes.bounded_read: The complete jarque_bera function and the complete skew and kurtosis estimator functions it calls were read, including defaults, formulas, references, examples, finite-sample warning, bias branches, degenerate-input behavior, and return contract. The pinned implementation uses biased central moments by default, Fisher excess kurtosis, and statistic n/6*(s^2+k^2/4).
routes.claim_boundary: Supports deterministic statistic arithmetic and the warning that chi-square inference is asymptotic and unsuitable at this small sample. It does not establish a WTI trading edge, the 48-return sample, the empirical-median state boundary, continuation direction, CFD equivalence, activity, profitability, or portfolio fit. No p-value is imported.

routes.bounded_read: The complete TestJarqueBera class was read. Its five-value R-compatible vector fixes statistic 0.17651605223752, and its remaining cases cover array shapes and too-few observations.
routes.claim_boundary: Supplies one independent arithmetic fixture only; the p-value, random example, and other library behavior do not enter the EA.
